races.name: Royal Pigeon Association Handicap

runners_data.name: Mereside Princess
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who raced too freely when stepped up to 1m, needs to settle better to be effective over this trip
runners_data.comment: Ran quite well over 7f last month but raced too freely when upped to 1m on Monday
runners_data.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; shaped quite well before fading into sixth at Southwell (7f, AW) last month but raced too freely and was safely held when upped to 1m at Redcar (good to firm; behind Harswell River) on Monday.

runners_data.name: Truly Special
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 171-day break, placed form gives hope but needs to bounce back from poor final run
runners_data.comment: Placed in Leicester nursery for David O'meara in October; off since lesser run in November
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in Leicester nursery (1m, good) for David O'Meara in October but signed off for him with down-the-field AW run in November and needs to rebound on this stable debut.

runners_data.name: City Of Dreams
runners_data.note: Prominent style, in good current form with two solid AW runs this year including recent fourth when hampered
runners_data.comment: Launched handicap career with two good AW runs this year, and may still have potential
runners_data.spotlight: Launched handicap career with two good AW runs this year; short of room at crucial stage before keeping on for fourth at Southwell (1m) this month and might have a bigger effort in him if this switch to turf suits.

runners_data.name: Harswell River
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner in good form, third at Redcar on Monday suggests he's ready to strike from the front
runners_data.comment: Looks fully exposed after 16 starts but ran well when placed at Redcar on Monday
runners_data.spotlight: Looks fully exposed after 16 starts but has performed well on both appearances this year, more recently when third of 12 at Redcar (1m, good to firm) on Monday; probably won't be far away.

runners_data.name: Alice's Influence
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who's unexposed after only four starts, front-ran on debut but likely better held up at this trip
runners_data.comment: Ran quite well from the front when fourth on handicap debut; might be aided by visor here
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed after only four starts and put in fairly good front-running shift before weakening into fourth on last month's seasonal/handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW); harmed her chance by persistently hanging right there and may improve if the new visor helps to keep her focused here.

runners_data.name: Liquid Cooled
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner stepping back up in trip after winning over 6f, recent fourth over 6f was perfect prep for this
runners_data.comment: Finished well for 6f win on handicap debut; looks interesting on this first attempt at 1m
runners_data.spotlight: Finished well to make winning seasonal/handicap debut at Newcastle (6f, AW) in March, and this month's fourth of 14 at Pontefract (6f, good to soft) was perfectly respectable; has some stamina on his dam's side and looks interesting on this first attempt at 1m.

runners_data.name: Gloriola
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with tendency to fade in finish, needs to find more stamina to be competitive over this distance

runners_data.name: Hood Wink
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who looked unlucky last time at Redcar, nine-race maiden but Tim Easterby 6/78 record suggests patience needed
runners_data.comment: 0-9, but looked unlucky not to finish closer than seventh at Redcar on Monday; e-w claims
runners_data.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; ran poorly on seasonal debut ten days ago but looked unlucky not to finish closer than seventh at Redcar on Monday (1m, good to firm; denied clear run); not ruled out each-way.

races.paceDynamic: Harswell River will take this along from the front with minimal pressure early, creating a sustainable tempo that should suit his confirmed front-running style. The prominent runners Truly Special, City Of Dreams and Gloriola will track him in the early stages, but none are aggressive pace-pressers. With most of the field comprised of hold-up horses (Mereside Princess, Alice's Influence, Liquid Cooled, Hood Wink), the pace will be controlled through the middle stages before quickening late. This measured pace scenario strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can secure good positions without early pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River gets an uncontested lead and sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: He can dictate terms throughout and prove hard to peg back, while the prominent trackers get first run on the field. The hold-up horses face a wall of horses and insufficient pace to close effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the strong pace they need in the final three furlongs to unleash their finishing kicks. Liquid Cooled's recent winning form and Mereside Princess's speed become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River sets steady fractions but weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: City Of Dreams or Truly Special can strike from their tracking positions with perfectly timed runs. Their tactical speed from prominent positions proves superior to both the tiring leader and the closing pack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Alice's Influence or Hood Wink gets a perfect run through from the back
scenarios.body: Their inexperience at this level works in their favor as they avoid traffic problems that trap the other hold-up horses. The race falls apart tactically and allows an outsider to pick up the pieces late.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Harswell River gets pressured for the lead early, as he needs to dictate his own pace to be effective
Monitor Gloriola's position turning for home - her fading tendency means she needs to be closer than usual to threaten
Check how quickly Liquid Cooled and Hood Wink can get into contention - both need clear runs from hold-up positions
Observe if Truly Special shows any ring-rustiness early after 171-day absence, could determine if he can track the pace effectively
Watch for Alice's Influence to get cover early rather than race keenly, as her inexperience could lead to tactical errors

races.name: Bet With The On-Course Bookmakers Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Cliff Danger
runners_data.note: Debut runner from dam who won at this trip for same stable, breeding suggests stamina but style unknown
runners_data.comment: Out of a useful bumper/Flat winner for the stable; has good standard to reach on debut
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam useful bumper and 1m6f Flat (RPR 101) winner for the stable, half-sister to winners John Clare (7f) and Special Mayson (6f/7f); has good standard to reach on debut.

runners_data.name: Ervani
runners_data.note: Well-bred Burke newcomer related to multiple winners including Group 2 performer, strong stable form recently
runners_data.comment: Out of a useful half-sister to two Gold Cup winners; makes appeal on paper
runners_data.spotlight: Tenth foal; closely related to a French 1m1f/1m2f winner, half-brother to five winners including Eziyra (7f-1m4f including Group 2; RPR 114), Etneya (1m; 101) and Eshera (1m including Listed; 96); dam 9.4f/1m4f winner (99), half-sister to two Gold Cup winners; makes appeal on paper.

runners_data.name: Princling
runners_data.note: Only proven front runner with 177 days off but retains fitness from Haggas yard, holds all the tactical cards

runners_data.name: Helios Path
runners_data.note: Soundly beaten in two starts with cheekpieces removed, hard to recommend despite trip drop
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten on first two starts
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten on first two starts, more recently on seasonal debut at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) this month; drops back in trip here; cheekpieces removed after one use.

runners_data.name: Picture Palace
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but form level modest, frame finisher on AW who may struggle with class rise
runners_data.comment: Made the frame on both 1m AW starts but the form isn't anything to go wild about
runners_data.spotlight: Made the frame on both 1m AW starts this year but no match for easy winner when second of four at Chelmsford on first occasion and beaten over 7l when fourth (promoted to third) at Kempton last time; gelded last month; improvement required.

runners_data.name: Lorton Valley
runners_data.note: Hold-up style disadvantaged by likely pace scenario, better suited for handicaps after qualifying
runners_data.comment: Displayed promise on both AW starts but run-of-the-mill handicaps beckon
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed promise when fifth in two 1m AW novice races in February/March but will probably be of greater interest when qualified for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Oathbound
runners_data.note: Haggas second string with hold-up style, 157 days off creates fitness doubts despite stable excellence

runners_data.name: Freddie Steady Go
runners_data.note: Former bumper winner returning from wind operation, stamina proven but needs pace collapse
runners_data.comment: Won a bumper last year but struggled on hurdle debut; best watched on Flat debut
runners_data.spotlight: Created good impression when winning good-ground Newcastle bumper on debut last April but was very disappointing on hurdle debut there in January (had wind op soon afterwards); probably best watched on Flat debut.

runners_data.name: Unchartedterritory
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 220 days absence, form level insufficient but style gives tactical hope
runners_data.comment: Respectable fourth at Ayr in September; should have more improvement to come this year
runners_data.spotlight: Well-bred gelding who bettered low-key 2yo debut when respectable fourth of seven at Ayr (1m, good to soft) in September; should have more improvement to come this year but a minor role may be his best hope here.

races.paceDynamic: Princling is the sole confirmed front runner and will set an uncontested lead from the gate, creating a sustainable tempo without early pressure. Picture Palace and Unchartedterritory are the only other prominent runners but lack the natural pace to challenge Princling early. The majority field consists of hold-up horses including Oathbound, Lorton Valley, and Freddie Steady Go, while the two newcomers Cliff Danger and Ervani add tactical uncertainty. This pace setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good early positions without energy expenditure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Princling maintains his lead without serious challenge through the first half mile
scenarios.body: The Haggas runner can dictate fractions and save energy for a sustained drive, while hold-up horses face the impossible task of making up ground against a horse with something left. Princling's proven stamina at the trip becomes decisive when others are struggling to close.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomers Deliver Class
scenarios.trigger: If either Cliff Danger or Ervani show natural ability from good breeding
scenarios.body: The pace collapse allows superior natural talent to emerge, with these well-bred types having the raw ability to overcome inexperience. Burke's strong record and the quality pedigrees suggest hidden potential despite debut conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with Princling pressed by prominent runners
scenarios.body: A true stamina test develops where patient tactics pay dividends in the final furlong. Oathbound's Haggas connection and previous form suggest he could benefit most from a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical enough for a horse with a turn of foot to emerge from the back. This scenario requires multiple pace miscalculations but could suit a horse saving maximum energy.

watchPoints.text: Princling's fitness after 177 days absence could be crucial if he shows any signs of blowing up in the final furlong
Watch market moves on Cliff Danger and Ervani as stable confidence indicators given their debut status
Early positioning will be critical - any prominent runner who settles closer than expected to Princling gains significant advantage
Freddie Steady Go's breathing and wind operation recovery can be assessed in the preliminaries
Track conditions may favor horses drawn on specific sides if ground varies across the course width

races.name: Vertu Mazda York Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Sea The Storm
runners_data.comment: Trained as 2yo by D Menuisier (same owners); won debut and second in a German Group 3
runners_data.spotlight: Trained as 2yo by David Menuisier (same owners); Sea The Stars filly who overcame evident inexperience to emerge well on top in a maiden at Sandown (1m, soft) in September on debut; 4-5 for Group 3 at Baden-Baden (1m, soft) five weeks later, which she didn't win but her running-on second of eight suggested she could be a very useful prospect and is far and away the best performance in this field.

runners_data.name: Matilda Bea
runners_data.comment: 8,000euros yearling by Australia; half-sister to five winners, notably Nicklaus (RPR 99)
runners_data.spotlight: 25,000euros foal, 8,000euros yearling; tenth foal; Australia half-sister to five winners, notably Nicklaus (6f-1m; RPR 99); dam German 1m-1m4f winner (including 2yo/Listed; 101); she'd have to be red hot on debut to beat an on-song Sea The Storm, though.

runners_data.name: Ceinture d'Orion
runners_data.comment: 210,000euros yearling by Sea The Stars; faces a good rival on debut but respected on paper
runners_data.spotlight: 210,000euros yearling by Sea The Stars; 11th foal; closely related to 9.4f-1m2f AW winner Demonstration (RPR 91), half-sister to five winners including Jouska (5f 2yo/6f Listed; 107) and Wasim (6.5f-7f including 2yo/dirt; 102); dam US 1m winner; faces a good rival on debut but respected on paper.

runners_data.name: Pierian
runners_data.comment: Lots to like on pedigree; as stablemate of Sea The Storm, the betting can give huge clues
runners_data.spotlight: Ninth foal; Palace Pier close relation to 1m2f winner Noble Horizon (RPR 95), half-sister to six winners including Thunder Drum (1m3f/1m4f including Group 3; 105) and Dubhe (1m-2m; 103); dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (including Irish Oaks; 118), sister to King George winner Nathaniel; lots to like there but, as stablemate of Sea The Storm, the betting should give all-important clues.

runners_data.name: Wadacre Geisha
runners_data.comment: Better at Beverley (8.5f) 11 days ago but that was still a 15l defeat and low-level form
runners_data.spotlight: Has run twice this spring, improving at Beverley (8.5f, good to soft) 11 days ago but that was still a 15l defeat and low-level form.

runners_data.name: Lady Buttercup
runners_data.comment: Bumper win 2024 but 0-7 over hurdles, followed by two low-level efforts under Flat rules
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner in September 2024 but 0-7 over hurdles, followed by two low-level performances under Flat rules; best watched for now.

races.name: Book Tickets Online At wetherbyracing.co.uk Handicap

runners_data.name: Evening Blues
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally suited to track the early pace, though 130 days off needs factoring into fitness equation
runners_data.comment: 1m AW maiden winner in November; off since second in a claimer in December; stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: 1m maiden winner at Dundalk (AW) for Ger Lyons in November, his fifth start; absent since second in a claimer over that C&D in December and, given his tendency to race too freely, removing the hood on this stable debut looks risky.

runners_data.name: Hasbro Market
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with Tudhope's tactical awareness, but 218 days absence is a significant concern for sharpness
runners_data.comment: Second in valuable Ayr novice in September; makes handicap debut after seven-month break
runners_data.spotlight: Delivered on debut promise when winning Thirsk novice (7f, good to firm) last August and probably bettered that form when second in a quite valuable Ayr race (7f, soft) a few weeks later; makes handicap debut after seven-month absence (gelded in the autumn) but should have more to offer.

runners_data.name: Beyond The Bar
runners_data.note: Prominent style perfectly matches race shape, excellent recent Easterby strike rate provides confidence

runners_data.name: Gold Queen Kindly
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist needing strong early pace, recent Southwell second suggests return to form
runners_data.comment: No match for winner when second at Southwell this month; more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Well down the field in two valuable AW handicaps at start of this year but this month's second at Southwell (7f, AW) was much better, albeit no match for the winner; probably needs another step forward.

runners_data.name: Shahik
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose headgear addition could provide the edge needed to capitalize on ideal racing position
runners_data.comment: Safely held in a Listed race on stable debut but this handicap debut is more realistic
runners_data.spotlight: Changed hands for 55,000gns after winning a small-field Newcastle maiden (6f, AW) in October, his third start; unable to land any sort of blow in 7f AW Listed race for new stable in February but has sights lowered on this handicap debut; sports first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Sanaam
runners_data.note: Front runner whose 135-day break may compromise ability to sustain strong early pace over 7f trip
runners_data.comment: Clear winner of Southwell maiden in December; form well advertised by runner-up
runners_data.spotlight: Came good at third attempt, with clear success in Southwell maiden (7f, AW; first run as a gelding) in December; not seen since but the form has been well advertised by the runner-up; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Back To Me
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace materializes, recent Southwell success shows current form level
runners_data.comment: Good winner of AW novice on stable debut; this race is tougher but he remains unexposed
runners_data.spotlight: Left inauspicious debut a long way behind when winning 6f AW maiden in Ireland in November and followed up in Southwell novice (7f, AW) for new stable three weeks ago; has more on his plate in this handicap and needs to prove himself on turf but remains unexposed.

runners_data.name: Harswell Angel
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent Newmarket run suggests still finding feet after seasonal reappearance
runners_data.comment: Ran okay on seasonal debut but never really looked threatening at Newmarket last time
runners_data.spotlight: Made a quite encouraging seasonal debut last month (6f, AW) but never really looked threatening when midfield at Newmarket (7f, good) 12 days ago and needs to up his game.

runners_data.name: Passing Thought
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 183-day absence, needs pace to develop for effective challenge
runners_data.comment: Off since October but the form of last summer's Goodwood second reads well
runners_data.spotlight: Perhaps a shade disappointing when upped to 7f for soft-ground Listed race on final 2yo start but won Hamilton maiden (6f, soft) in September and the form of her close second at Goodwood (6f, good) in August reads well; still has untapped potential over this trip and beyond; interesting.

runners_data.name: Dacres Cross
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse moving up in trip after 202-day break, others hold stronger current form claims
runners_data.comment: 2yo campaign fizzled out after 6f nursery win last August; up in trip for reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Won five-runner Carlisle nursery (6f, good) last summer but his 2yo campaign fizzled out somewhat; moves up in trip for this reappearance; others have less to prove.

runners_data.name: Supreme Clarets
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose recent reappearance suggests needing this outing to find full fitness
runners_data.comment: Largely consistent as a 2yo but made a low-key reappearance a fortnight ago; now 0-7
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; largely consistent as a 2yo but made a low-key reappearance a fortnight ago (1m) and needs to have taken significant benefit from that outing.

races.paceDynamic: Sanaam and Hasbro Market will ensure a genuine gallop from the off, with both having natural early speed and the tactical nous of Marquand and Tudhope respectively. The pace should be honest rather than breakneck over this 7f trip, creating opportunities for those tracking just behind the leaders like Evening Blues, Beyond The Bar, and Shahik. With multiple hold-up horses including Gold Queen Kindly, Back To Me, and Harswell Angel relying on a strong pace, the early tempo will be crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters duel early and weaken in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for those tracking in third or fourth, allowing them to strike when the leaders tire. Beyond The Bar and Evening Blues are ideally positioned to capitalize on this most likely scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: Hasbro Market or Sanaam could steal a march if the other doesn't engage early, leaving them with too much in hand for the closers. The winner comes from those with natural early pace who can dictate terms.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with both leaders committed
scenarios.body: A fierce early battle would perfectly suit the patient types coming from behind in the final two furlongs. Gold Queen Kindly and Back To Me thrive when given something to aim at late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters are withdrawn or fail to engage properly
scenarios.body: A slowly-run race would become a sprint finish where the best turn of foot wins regardless of early position. This tactical lottery could throw up any winner from those with natural speed.

watchPoints.text: Hasbro Market and Sanaam both missing since last year could lack race fitness for sustained pace battle
Beyond The Bar has ideal race position but Easterby runners can be unpredictable first time out this season
Evening Blues returning after 130 days could either need the run or benefit from Foley's 5lb claim in tight finish
Gold Queen Kindly needs the leaders to go hard early but recent form suggests vulnerability if pace doesn't develop
Back To Me represents Irish form that could be stronger than it appears on paper

races.name: Constant Security Services Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Secret History
runners_data.note: Hold-up style returning after 87 days off with hood fitted for first time, may need this run despite her ability
runners_data.comment: Didn't have to improve to win at Chelmsford in January (6f); clear potential now h'capping
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't need to improve on her 2yo form to win a 6f fillies' novice at Chelmsford in January; returns to 7f with a hood fitted; brings untapped potential to this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Rosa Inglesa
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 204 days with useful 7f form as a 2-year-old, trainer's strike-rate is modest recently
runners_data.comment: Promising at 7f last year; moves into handicaps with the potential for better
runners_data.spotlight: Useful ability over 7f as a 2yo, winning a Chelmsford novice on her second start and finishing a creditable sixth in a big-field sales race at Newmarket when last seen; likely there is more to come and she is an interesting handicap debutante.

runners_data.name: Mereside Diva
runners_data.note: Hold-up type carrying top weight but showed improved form when blinkered, consistent at this trip
runners_data.comment: Running well this year and returning to turf won't do her any harm; likely to go well
runners_data.spotlight: Two good runs at Southwell preceded her Newcastle success in February (7f; blinkered first time); she hasn't run badly at Lingfield twice since, for all she has finished down the field, and this test may prove more suitable; key player.

runners_data.name: Art Gallery
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with progressive profile, won last two starts and had more in hand than margin suggested
runners_data.comment: Chasing a hat-trick after AW wins at Newcastle (7f) and Kempton (1m); solid contender
runners_data.spotlight: Improved with each of her four starts, winning a 7f novice at Newcastle in December and adding a 1m handicap at Kempton four weeks ago; had more to spare than the winning margin of a neck might indicate on that occasion and a 5lb rise may not prove insurmountable.

runners_data.name: Come On Eibhlin
runners_data.note: Prominent early but fades in finish, often highly tried and unplaced in both handicap attempts
runners_data.comment: Unplaced in both handicap runs; may need more weight off her back
runners_data.spotlight: Often highly tried at two (made her debut in the Queen Mary) but did manage to win a 6f fillies' novice at Windsor; unplaced in both handicap runs and could probably do with some more weight off her back.

runners_data.name: Miss Lady Grace
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who dictated steady pace when winning maiden, struggled when stepped up in class
runners_data.comment: Dictated when winning at Wolverhampton; last of seven on handicap debut; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Dictated a steady pace when winning a 7f maiden at Wolverhampton in February; last of seven on her handicap debut (6f, AW) last month; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: In A Hurry
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 190 days off with hood fitted, needs to bounce back from poor final two runs at 3
runners_data.comment: Ended 2025 quietly but this mark in range judged on her progressive form beforehand
runners_data.spotlight: Ended her 3yo campaign with two lesser efforts but she had been on the up beforehand; this mark should be in range if she is ready to roll after 190 days off.

runners_data.name: Folkene
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who hasn't progressed from impressive debut win but shaped better last time at Doncaster
runners_data.comment: Sharper for last month's return to action; could yet rate higher
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to kick on from her impressive winning stable debut last summer but she didn't run badly in a big-field handicap at Doncaster four weeks ago and that run should have tightened her up; could yet rate higher.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Lady Grace will lead from the gates with Rosa Inglesa and Come On Eibhlin likely to press forward early, creating a modest pace over this 7f trip. The prominent runners may settle just behind the leaders, while the hold-up horses Secret History, Art Gallery, Mereside Diva and Folkene will need to rely on a strong finish. With only one confirmed front runner and several hold-up types, this sets up as a tactical affair where the pace may not be strong enough early. This race shape favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, rather than pure hold-up horses who may find themselves with too much to do.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Lady Grace dictates an uncontested lead with moderate early fractions
scenarios.body: The front runners and prominent racers get first run while hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the lack of pace. Those positioned within striking distance can pounce when the race develops.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners Rosa Inglesa and Come On Eibhlin apply more pressure to Miss Lady Grace than expected
scenarios.body: A stronger gallop unfolds allowing the backmarkers to close effectively in the final furlong. The class horses with finishing kicks can sweep past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with multiple horses vying for position mid-race
scenarios.body: Those with tactical pace who can adapt to the changing rhythm gain the advantage over pure speed or pure stamina types. Jockey skills become crucial in the final quarter-mile.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Lady Grace gets completely uncontested fractions and the field settles too far back
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the pack leaves their challenge too late on the good ground. Speed holds up better than expected over this 7f trip.

watchPoints.text: Miss Lady Grace may get uncontested fractions if Rosa Inglesa and Come On Eibhlin don't press forward aggressively enough
Secret History and In A Hurry both returning from lengthy breaks may need a run to reach peak fitness
Art Gallery's progressive profile makes her dangerous if the hold-up horses get the right pace setup
Come On Eibhlin's tendency to fade in the finish could see her weaken quickly if drawn into early pace battle
The good ground conditions favour those with tactical speed over pure front-runners at this 7f distance

races.name: Lives Streams On Racing TV Extra Handicap

runners_data.name: Chesneys Charm
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who hasn't shown his York form this year and faces a tactical disadvantage in a race full of similar styles
runners_data.comment: Not found his form in two runs this year; drawn widest and others are more appealing

runners_data.name: Zarathos
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who drops in class after his reappearance and should benefit from the lack of early pace pressure
runners_data.comment: Exposed maiden but regularly placed; down in grade with his reappearance behind him

runners_data.name: Hale End
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 61-day break who was consistent at Southwell but faces traffic problems here
runners_data.comment: Five-time winner, the latest at Southwell in December; each-way shout back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: He was winning for the fifth time when landing a 1m handicap at Southwell in December; not far short of that level in defeat on his next two starts; each-way shout if getting a good pace to aim at.

runners_data.name: Dark Rosa
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who may improve for having her seasonal reappearance run at Bath behind her
runners_data.comment: May come on for her recent Bath 7th; Harry Vigors takes off a useful 7lb; not discounted
runners_data.spotlight: Shot back up the weights after an easy win at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in November; latest Bath run was after a 12-week absence and she may fare better today with her rider's 7lb claim useful.

runners_data.name: Mount King
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent Pontefract flop could have sharpened him but tactical setup works against him
runners_data.comment: Needs to build on his Pontefract reappearance but that's not out of the question
runners_data.spotlight: His last three wins have come over 1m at Pontefract but he finished down the field at that track on his recent return to action; that run could have sharpened him up and he is on a winning mark; not ruled out.

runners_data.name: American State
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in form after wind operation but will struggle in traffic with so many similar runners
runners_data.comment: 2-3 since a wind op and a 4lb rise for his latest Southwell success doesn't look excessive
runners_data.spotlight: Took his record to 2-3 since a wind operation when keeping on well in a 1m handicap at Southwell three weeks ago; up 4lb but he has shown comparable ability on turf and should give it another good go.

runners_data.name: Lever Up
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden returning from 236 days with tongue tie fitted for the first time
runners_data.comment: 0-10 but did show some promise last year; tongue tied for his return; betting to guide
runners_data.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; bits of form last summer that bring him into the reckoning and he kicks off his 4yo campaign with a tongue tie fitted; betting useful back from 236 days off.

runners_data.name: Harswell Ruby
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in peak form after Thirsk win but faces same traffic issues as other back-markers
runners_data.comment: Well backed when winning at Thirsk 16 days ago (1m, good); one to consider up 3lb
runners_data.spotlight: Stepped up on her seasonal return when justifying favouritism in a 1m handicap at Thirsk 16 days ago (good ground); well backed on that occasion and a 3lb higher mark may not be beyond her.

runners_data.name: Rajapour
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse now 2lb lower than his last win but recent form suggests he's regressing
runners_data.comment: On a dangerous mark but out of sorts in recent starts; new headgear not enough to tempt
runners_data.spotlight: Now 2lb lower than for December's Wolverhampton success (8.6f; visored first time) but that is a result of some poor runs since; change of headgear not enough to tempt.

runners_data.name: Dovey Moon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 193-day break off a higher mark than his previous wins
runners_data.comment: Three 1m handicap wins this year; another career best needed after 193 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Good progress as a 3yo, winning 1m handicaps at Chepstow (twice) and Nottingham, all on good ground; starts this year off a tougher mark; can win more races but perhaps not this one after 193 days off.

runners_data.name: West Tyrone
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader who gets uncontested lead but hasn't shown much progression since his Southwell win
runners_data.comment: Didn't progress for Kevin Ryan and he needs to leave his stable/seasonal debut behind him
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't progress as may have been expected following a 1m win at Southwell last March; dropped away to finish eighth of the nine runners on last month's stable debut at Newcastle (1m); enough to prove for now.

runners_data.name: Sea Suite
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in form after recent Southwell win and avoids the hold-up traffic problems

races.paceDynamic: West Tyrone will lead from the start with Zarathos and Dovey Moon tracking in behind, but without genuine pressure this creates a moderate tempo rather than a searching gallop. The large field of hold-up horses (Chesneys Charm, Hale End, Dark Rosa, Mount King, American State, Lever Up, Harswell Ruby, Rajapour) will settle towards the back, waiting for the race to develop. With 10 of 12 runners preferring to come from off the pace, the early leaders will face minimal pressure through the middle sections before a cavalry charge develops in the final 2-3 furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers who can position close enough to the pace without getting caught in the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Zarathos or Sea Suite can track the moderate pace without getting trapped behind the wall of hold-up horses.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows prominent runners to conserve energy while avoiding the traffic jam that develops when 10 hold-up horses try to find room simultaneously. Zarathos drops in class and should be sharper after his reappearance, while Sea Suite's recent Southwell win shows he's in form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If West Tyrone sets a steady pace and the hold-up horses leave their challenges too late.
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead allows West Tyrone to dictate terms and kick for home before the back-markers can organize their challenges. Despite his poor recent form, the tactical advantage of an easy lead on good ground could see him defy the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the better hold-up horses (Harswell Ruby, American State) gets a clear passage through the inevitable traffic.
scenarios.body: Harswell Ruby's recent Thirsk win on good ground shows she's in peak form and could time her challenge perfectly if avoiding trouble. American State's wind operation has transformed him and his recent Southwell success suggests he's ready for this step up in grade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy scramble and an unfancied runner gets first run on the field.
scenarios.body: The sheer number of hold-up horses creates potential for an unfancied runner like Lever Up (returning from 236 days with tongue tie) to slip through while the fancied horses are still sorting themselves out. Dark Rosa's trainer switch and return to form cycle could also see her benefit from a chaotic finish.

watchPoints.text: West Tyrone could steal this if he gets too easy a lead with 10 hold-up horses giving him a soft time of it
Traffic problems will be severe in the straight with 10 hold-up horses all looking for room simultaneously
Zarathos and Sea Suite are the only prominent runners who can avoid getting caught behind the wall of hold-up horses
Harswell Ruby's recent Thirsk win shows peak form but she needs luck in running from her hold-up style
American State's transformation since his wind operation makes him dangerous if getting a clear passage

races.name: Its Ladies' Day On 4th June Handicap

runners_data.name: Ingleby Archie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 184-day break but goes well fresh and won off higher mark at York
runners_data.comment: Starts his campaign off a handy mark and he has gone well fresh in the past; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Prominent racer who goes well fresh; 1lb lower than when seeing off 19 rivals at York last May (6f, good); should be in the thick of the action.

runners_data.name: King's Crown
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with cheekpieces returning, better on AW recently but drops to Class 5 company
runners_data.comment: Gone off the boil of late but returning cheekpieces and drop back into a Class 5 can help
runners_data.spotlight: Two AW wins at Newcastle over the winter; his form has cooled more recently but today's return to Class 5 company will help and the cheekpieces return after being discarded last time.

runners_data.name: Dorney Lake
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with hood and tongue-tie applied, ran just four days ago which may compromise fitness

runners_data.name: Shavkat
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner for new connections, showed promise for Varian but unproven for current trainer
runners_data.comment: Not at best on stable debut last month but his opening mark looks manageable; considered
runners_data.spotlight: Two solid efforts for Roger Varian last summer, winning a 6f maiden at Lingfield (AW) on debut before finishing third under a penalty at Doncaster (6f, good to firm); not so good on his stable debut at Lingfield last month (after nine months off) but he looks to be on a fair mark for his handicap debut.

runners_data.name: True Promise
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with consistent AW form but moderate turf record creates questions
runners_data.comment: Running well in defeat on AW for current yard; has a bit more to prove on turf
runners_data.spotlight: String of good AW runs for current yard since December; his turf record is less compelling but he has been placed on good ground; others are preferred for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Alpine Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with hood fitted, five-time turf winner only 2lb higher than last success
runners_data.comment: On a good mark and she needs serious consideration now returning to turf
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time turf winner; only 2lb higher than for her Redcar win last summer (6f, good to firm) and her two AW runs this year aren't the ones to judge her on (blindfold slow to be removed last time); leading contender.

runners_data.name: Without Flaw
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 170-day absence, won twice at Beverley last July but rusty risk
runners_data.comment: Two 5f wins last summer; ran well fresh in 2025; others perhaps better treated here
runners_data.spotlight: Won two 5f handicaps at Beverley in the space of a week last July; went close off 1lb lower at Pontefract in October; ran well on last year's seasonal debut but just a suspicion others are better handicapped.

runners_data.name: Glory Hyde
runners_data.note: Hold-up style, dropped 3lb this year but recent efforts suggest she may need this run
runners_data.comment: Dropped to a dangerous mark and neither run this year has been without hope; contender
runners_data.spotlight: Dropped 3lb in her two runs this year yet neither has been without hope, perhaps in need of the run on the first occasion and then poorly drawn at Doncaster last time; better effort expected today.

races.paceDynamic: True Promise and Ingleby Archie will set a measured pace from the front, with both confirmed prominent runners likely to share early duties over this 5½f trip. Without Flaw may also press forward early given his prominent style, creating a trio of pace influences that should produce a sustainable tempo rather than breakneck fractions. The majority of the field (King's Crown, Dorney Lake, Shavkat, Alpine Girl, Glory Hyde) are hold-up performers who will settle behind and rely on finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners and early pace-setters, as they can control the tempo without excessive pressure and prove difficult to peg back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise and Ingleby Archie dictate a steady tempo from the front
scenarios.body: The pace-setters get an uncontested lead and can quicken when they choose, making it difficult for the hold-up brigade to close the gap in time. The prominent runners have tactical control and superior positioning throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple prominent runners pressing
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing the hold-up performers to unleash devastating late runs from their patient positions. King's Crown and Alpine Girl benefit most from this closing kick scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Tempo Shift
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise kicks clear mid-race and stretches the field
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage through superior tactical positioning while the hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the tempo increase. Without Flaw may track the move best of the remainder.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Drama
scenarios.trigger: If all three prominent runners (True Promise, Ingleby Archie, Without Flaw) go too fast early
scenarios.body: They set unsustainable fractions and tie up badly in the final furlong, allowing a patient hold-up horse to sweep past with a well-timed run. Shavkat or Dorney Lake could capitalize from their tracking positions.

watchPoints.text: True Promise could steal a march if he gets uncontested fractions early and kicks clear turning for home
Ingleby Archie's 184-day absence may tell late despite his fresh running ability and strong York form
Without Flaw faces fitness concerns after 170 days off but could surprise if retaining last year's Beverley sharpness
King's Crown's cheekpieces return and class drop could spark improvement from recent moderate AW efforts
The hold-up majority (five runners) need the pace to collapse to have realistic winning chances
